title: Graphic Design and Marketing Intern – Summer 2027
note: Paid brand-communications internship for juniors or seniors in graphic design, visual communication or marketing; a PDF or online portfolio is required.

facts.summary: Paid summer internship with Radio Flyer's Brand Communications team at its Chicago headquarters.
facts.duties: Design digital and print brand assets for campaigns, social media, retail packaging and launches; make internal event graphics; write product copy; help at photo and video shoots.
facts.requirements: Junior or senior in graphic design, visual communication and/or marketing with a 3.0+ GPA; Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign; After Effects is a plus.
facts.apply: Apply through Radio Flyer's ADP careers page with a resume and a PDF portfolio or portfolio link. A relocation stipend may be offered to applicants from outside Chicagoland.
